// Urls: Deliberately not set here. A value in appsettings wins over ASPNETCORE_URLS, which would stop E2E and deployments from choosing their own address. Development and ManualTesting pin a port; everything else uses ASPNETCORE_URLS.
// Q2: The zone a person's days are counted in when their account is created, how often the goal maintenance job looks for expired windows, where uploaded pictures are kept, the prompts the daily challenge publishes, and the keys notifications are signed with. Written down rather than implicit: a deadline decides whether somebody keeps a streak, so 'whatever the server thinks a day is' is not good enough. See docs/adr/0016-windows-instead-of-steps.md and docs/adr/0017-image-storage.md.

Q2.// Images: Empty RootPath means 'images' beside the database file. It must never point inside a directory a static file handler serves: a picture reaches a browser through /api/images/{id} and a session check, or not at all.
Q2.// Push: Web Push (RFC 8291/8292). Empty keys turn notifications off, which is the default and a supported state — nothing breaks, the settings screen says so. Generate a P-256 pair and put the private half in the environment as Q2__Push__PrivateKey; it is a credential like the Sentry DSN and does not belong in this file. Subject is a mailto: or https URL a push service can use to reach whoever runs the deployment. See docs/adr/0023-web-push.md.
Q2.// Challenges: The daily challenge's prompts, and how many days ahead rows are written for them. This list is the editorial desk: there is no admin screen and no job that invents a prompt overnight. A day gets its prompt from the date, so the rotation is stable and adding one shifts only days that are not queued yet. An empty list turns the daily challenge off. See docs/adr/0021-daily-challenge.md.

Prompts: Zeig deinen Arbeitsplatz, so wie er gerade aussieht.
Fotografiere etwas Grünes in deiner Nähe.
Was steht heute auf deinem Teller?
Zeig den Blick aus deinem Fenster.
Ein Bild von etwas, das dich heute zum Lachen gebracht hat.
Zeig deine Schuhe — und wo sie heute schon waren.
Das erste Ding, das du heute Morgen in der Hand hattest.

// ConnectionStrings: Empty on purpose. Every environment supplies its own; Staging and Production must set ConnectionStrings__Database.
// Database: Safe defaults: an environment that configures nothing does nothing to its database.
// Sentry: Dsn comes from configuration or SENTRY_DSN and is never committed. Empty means the SDK initialises but sends nothing.
